name: E3
description: Proposed verification pipeline on canonical test sample
notes: Proposed pipeline with k = 3 paraphrases and r = 1 repair. The threshold is fixed at 0.8 until a calibration file exists: set "calibration" to a file from scripts/calibrate.py (made from pipeline_p3 records with the same signals and parser switch) and it replaces the threshold. Run the shift samples with --sample-file samples/constraint_pairs_60.json and samples/linguistic_60.json.
